newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to launch rollover T-bills this week.
newsitem.headline: Romania to launch rollover T-bills this week.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Monday it would launch 116.14 billion lei worth of 91-day treasury bills to cover papers due to mature this week.
The bills will be offered with an annual yield equal to the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five days before the public subscription scheduled for Thursday.
Three-month BUBID was 49.48 percent on Monday.
Official data show the January-September state budget had a 2.86-trillion lei deficit, which was expected to expand to 4.46 trillion by the end of 1996.
Commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients will be eligible to buy the T-bills. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
